name: Chimaeric Horn

meta.previous: Orm Stonehoof and the Brutal Helm

summary: Orm Stonehoof sends a Horde warrior into the Charred Vale to face a suffering chimaera matriarch. Her horn is needed for the Brutal Helm, and the hunt tests the warrior’s strength and mercy.

sections.title: A Test of Resolve
sections.body: Orm Stonehoof will forge the Brutal Helm for Horde warriors, but tradition calls for proof before he begins. He asks for more than metal or coin: the warrior must show martial skill and face the scars left by devastating conflict.

sections.title: The Scars of the Charred Vale
sections.body: In the southwestern Stonetalon Mountains, the Charred Vale lies in ash. Once lush and green, the valley was burned into a smoking wasteland. Beasts still wander its soot-covered craters, twisted by pain and fury. Mighty chimaeras nest among dead trees and searing steam vents.

sections.title: Mercy in Combat
sections.body: For the tauren smith, the chimaera matriarch’s horn is both a needed piece for the helm and proof of strength. The hunt also ends the matriarch’s torment. By felling her, the warrior brings mercy to a wild spirit driven mad by the destruction of its home.

faq.answer: Orm Stonehoof is a skilled tauren blacksmith in Thunder Bluff who helps veteran Horde warriors craft their class armor, including the Brutal Helm.

faq.q: Why does Orm want the galvanized horn?
faq.answer: The galvanized horn is a durable part of the Brutal Helm and proof that the warrior had the courage to track and defeat a dangerous alpha predator in hazardous terrain.
Chimaeras are large, two-headed winged beasts native to Kalimdor. Fire and destruction in the Charred Vale have driven its surviving chimaeras violently mad.

faq.q: How does this quest fit into warrior training?
faq.answer: Around their thirtieth season, Horde warriors go to specialists such as Orm Stonehoof for dangerous trials. Completing these trials earns them the right to wear the heavy, spiked Brutal armor set made for battlefield champions.

faq.q: Why does Orm frame the hunt as an act of mercy?
faq.answer: Tauren culture honors harmony with the earth and its creatures. The Charred Vale’s inhabitants suffer from the devastation of their land, so slaying the matriarch is seen as ending her unrelenting pain, not as mindless slaughter.

angles.text: As a warrior, you prove your skill by hunting a solitary alpha beast in a brutal place, earning the right to wear the Brutal Helm.
As a tauren, you hear Orm Stonehoof’s reverence in his words: even in battle, ending a tormented beast’s suffering honors the Earth Mother.
As a member of the Horde, you push from Sun Rock Retreat into Stonetalon’s contested wilds to forge the arms needed for Kalimdor’s defense.
